game_title: Continue Gate – Moss Door Chamber Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled pickaxes but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled pickaxes but keep the loop running. Each round, skeleton miners strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber: keep the skipped_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: skipped_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
